# orion group

Wrap items that share a parent in a new group

```sh
orion group [options] [label...]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `[label...]` | Group name |
| `--items <value>` | **Required.** Comma-separated ids to put in it |
| `--json` | Print JSON |
